prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1065; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the rear quarter panel and passenger-side door shows scraping, a crease along the lower door skin, and a cracked rear bumper cover end, all consistent with a sideswipe while changing lanes as described. The damage pattern lines up with the reported impact, and nothing observed suggests older or unrelated harm. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, blending and refinishing the quarter panel, and straightening and refinishing the door. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the work, and the supporting invoices show no repeated charges. No prior damage to this vehicle is known to us.
